config.title: [cy] Agent Configuration
config.intro: [cy] Each agent reads its own config keys. Unknown keys are ignored. Defaults apply when a key is absent. See the help articles for the full schema.
inbox.title: [cy] 🤖 Agent Inbox
inbox.intro: [cy] Proposals from automated agents waiting on your review. Approving applies the proposal to the underlying record (e.g. creates a maintenance task or merges into an existing one). Rejecting trains the agent — please leave a reason.
inbox.emptyHint: [cy] Agents will surface their suggestions here for review.
inbox.rejectReasonLabel: [cy] Reason (helps the agent learn — please be specific)
inbox.rejectReasonPlaceholder: [cy] e.g. Not actually a complaint, was a joke / Already handled offline / Too speculative
knowledge.title: [cy] Knowledge Base
knowledge.intro: [cy] Knowledge entries ground the agents' reasoning. Scope determines visibility: GLOBAL applies everywhere, REGIONAL matches your region bucket, TENANT is your club only. More specific scopes win when titles overlap.
knowledge.noEntries: [cy] No knowledge entries match these filters.
